 Santos Faces Coritiba in Crucial Brazilian Serie A Match

 Santos FC travels to Curitiba to face Coritiba in Round 35 of the 2026 Campeonato Brasileiro Serie A on November 19. The match at Estadio Major Antonio Couto Pereira presents an opportunity for both clubs to improve their league positions, with Santos seeking to end a three-game winless run.
 According to the match preview published by Khel Now on November 18, Santos occupies ninth place after collecting 12 victories from 34 league appearances. The team managed by Cuca enters the fixture following a 1-2 defeat against Red Bull Bragantino before the international break.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 Coritiba also needs a positive result after losing 0-1 to Internacional in its previous league appearance. Fernando Seabra's team will play at home and look to recover from an inconsistent sequence of performances.
 Also Read 
 Neymar Returns as Santos Face Coritiba in Serie A 
 The match is scheduled for Estadio Major Antonio Couto Pereira in Curitiba. Braulio da Silva Machado will referee the contest, with video assistant referee technology in operation.
 Gabriel Barbosa is among Santos' main attacking options. The 30-year-old has recorded 19 goal contributions in 26 league appearances this season, including an assist in the team's previous match. He is expected to lead the attack as the central striker.
 For Coritiba, Pedro Rocha represents an important attacking presence. The 32-year-old has scored nine goals in 33 Brazilian Serie A appearances and is expected to operate on the left side of the attack.
 Also Read 
 Gremio Host Bahia in Crucial Serie A Relegation Clash 
 Coritiba will be without Lucas Ronier, who is sidelined for the remainder of the season because of a cruciate ligament injury. Santos faces several absences, including Gabriel Brazao, Vinicius Lira and Lucas Verissimo, who are injured. Gabriel Bontempo is away on national team duty, while Alvaro Barreal is suspended.
 The projected Coritiba lineup features Morisca in goal, with Tinga, Coser, Jacy and Melo in defense. Santos and Gomez are expected in midfield, while Lopes, Fonseca and Rocha support Josue in attack.
 Santos is projected to start with Diogenes as goalkeeper, supported by Rodinei, Alencar, Peres and Gonzaga in defense. Henrique and Oliva are expected in midfield, with Everton, Neymar and Coutinho operating behind Barbosa.
 Also Read 
 Santos Approach Real Madrid Over Rodrygo Loan Move 
 The teams have met 51 times, with nine encounters ending in draws. Only one of their five most recent meetings finished level, according to Khel Now. Coritiba's recent record includes one victory in its last three attempts, while Santos has gone three consecutive matches without winning.
 Separately, Santos FC issued a statement on November 13 explaining the commercial arrangements for its match against Gremio. The club said it had transferred the match's commercial rights to a third-party operator under an existing agreement and had already received the agreed net payment. The operator is responsible for ticket pricing and direct sales.
 The club also advised Sócio Rei members to keep their membership payments current because processing can take up to 24 hours. Ticket sale dates were still awaiting announcement, while supporters were encouraged to complete facial registration through the ingressosa.com platform.
 Also Read 
 Santos Expects Neymar Return Against Coritiba 
 Santos also announced arrangements for its Under-20 Campeonato Paulista semifinal against SE Palmeiras. The November 13 match at Mercado Livre Arena Pacaembu was scheduled for 3 p.m., with free admission through gates 7 and 9. Supporters could also donate non-perishable food at the stadium entrance.
 Santos entered that semifinal with a 2-1 advantage from the first leg at Arena Barueri, where Rodrigo Cézar and David Nogueira scored. A draw would be sufficient to secure qualification for the final as the club pursued consecutive Campeonato Paulista Under-20 titles.
